pyqgis_plugin.name: Fillet & Chamfer for QGIS 3.x (Interactive & Batch)
pyqgis_plugin.description: Interactive Fillet & Chamfer tool for QGIS 3.16-3.44 and Batch Fillet / Chamfer Tool for QGIS 3.16-4.0+.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Provides interactive CAD-like Fillet (corner rounding) and Chamfer (corner beveling) digitizing for QGIS 3.16-3.44, plus an instant Batch Processing panel for selected vector features in both QGIS 3.16-3.44 and QGIS 4.0+.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: cad, editing, fillet, chamfer, geometry, digitizing, curve, batch, qgis4
